questions.question: Which attention mask makes MiniGPT causal?
options: An upper-triangular mask that blocks attention to future token positions
A lower-triangular mask that blocks all previous context
A mask that allows every query to see every key
A mask that removes only padding embeddings
questions.explanation: The causal self-attention uses an upper-triangular future-position mask. Each token may attend to itself and earlier tokens, not tokens to its right.

questions.question: How does the training run combine ZeroOptimizer with distributed gradients?
options: Every rank keeps a full Adam state and rank 0 broadcasts only the loss
It reduce-scatters averaged gradients, updates a local Adam shard, and all-gathers parameters
It shards activations but never synchronizes parameters
It averages checkpoint files instead of gradients
questions.explanation: The stage-1 optimizer reduce-scatters flattened gradients, applies Adam to each rank's master/m/v shard, and all-gathers the updated master parameters back into the model.

questions.question: What happens at CHECKPOINT_STEP=10 in run_e2e?
options: Training stops permanently at step 10
Only rank 1 writes a local text log
Rank state is gathered to rank 0 and written through save_sharded
The optimizer state is discarded so the next run starts fresh
questions.explanation: At the checkpoint step, the run gathers the distributed state needed for a resumable checkpoint on rank 0 and invokes the sharded checkpoint writer.

questions.question: What does verify_resume compare after loading the saved checkpoint?
options: Only the printed loss at the final step
The vocabulary size against the batch size
The number of worker processes against the number of layers
Saved optimizer master_shard tensors against the in-memory snapshots byte for byte
questions.explanation: The resume check loads the checkpoint and compares each saved master_shard tensor with the snapshot retained at checkpoint time, requiring byte equality.

questions.question: What does the shard_bytes calculation count for each rank in this training demo?
options: Three fp32 arrays over one shard: master parameters, first moment, and second moment
Only the model's token embeddings
The full parameter vector in fp16 plus activations
One byte for each checkpoint metadata field
questions.explanation: Each local optimizer shard stores master, m, and v as fp32 values. The reported memory is chunk_numel * 4 * 3, separate from model and activation memory.

questions.question: Which result invariant does the end-to-end demo check over its training history?
options: There are exactly two loss values, both allowed to be NaN
There are 20 finite losses for the configured STEPS=20 run
Loss is constant because no optimizer step occurs
The loss list contains one value per vocabulary token
questions.explanation: The configured run performs 20 steps and the tests require a finite loss at each step. The history therefore has 20 usable values, even though loss need not decrease monotonically.
